semiconductor_relevance: High — EVIDENT Corporation specializes in inspection and measurement equipment critical for semiconductor manufacturing processes.
summary: EVIDENT Corporation provides advanced optical and precise measurement equipment designed to enhance productivity in semiconductor manufacturing. Their offerings include tools for defect detection, contamination analysis, and overlay measurement, which are essential for maintaining quality in semiconductor fabrication.
